records.title: Amendment 1, before any data: runner and grader separated, a secret salted A/B key committed by hash, a fresh model grader on blind packs
records.body: Filed before any review in this study has run. Corrects two flaws in the pre-registration's blinding, found by the author on rereading: the A/B relabelling used a published seed, which anyone could recompute, and the grader was to be the runner, who would know the arms. Now: Kannaka runs the reviews and does not grade; the A/B assignment was drawn with the secrets module and a 32-byte salt into a file held only by Flaukowski, whose sha256 is committed here (c87913d2738eb93f90e57bb3ffa956d05442bcd59d6a1afdb9e5bf80b00c2203) and which is published unchanged after every verdict; Flaukowski builds blind A/B packs with project-naming strings replaced and the replacement counts published; a fresh Claude instance with no access to the key, the raw reports or the runner's logs grades them, and is disclosed as a model grader. An outside second grader may grade the same packs beside it. Everything else in the pre-registration is unchanged.
